consequence.statement: This adds an optional AzureDNS managed-identity setting, `tenantID`, for multi-tenant environments. Existing configurations do not need to change.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds an optional `tenantID` setting to the AzureDNS DNS01 solver's managed identity configuration, so users can specify the tenant ID; existing configurations need no changes.
